title: The Simple Editorial Font
author: IM Studio
description:
Meet your new go-to serif — a typeface that feels like it was pulled straight from the golden age of print, yet belongs completely in today’s design landscape.
The Simple Editorial is a bold, versatile editorial serif built for designers who refuse to choose between classic and contemporary. Rooted in the visual language of vintage publications, iconic signage, and mid-century advertising, this typeface carries an unmistakable retro soul — while staying effortlessly at home in modern brand systems, editorial layouts, and luxury packaging.
15 styles. Endless range. With 9 carefully crafted weights plus matching italics, you get a full typographic toolkit — from whisper-thin elegance to commanding display weight. Add refined ligatures into the mix, and every headline, logotype, or body copy block carries that extra layer of craft.
Designed for versatility, built for impact. Whether you’re art-directing a heritage-inspired brand, laying out a high-end magazine spread, or crafting packaging that demands a second look — The Simple Editorial delivers. Every weight, every curve, every letter is designed to make an impression.
Whether you’re a brand designer, art director, or typographic enthusiast — The Simple Editorial gives your work the kind of personality that doesn’t fade.
